method: Every indexed chunk (1,063, all 124 files) read once, with no search involved, and judged against all 30 questions. A chunk is listed for a question only if it is relevant (grade 1-3); every other chunk is grade 0. Each entry quotes the chunk's own text (checked by tests) and says why.

grades.3: states the answer, or a core part of it, directly
grades.2: a needed supporting part of the answer
grades.1: related: says something about the topic that helps a little
grades.0: not relevant, including text that only names the topic
